# graviteeam_device_identifier (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Device Identifier plugin

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_device_identifier" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name      = "FingerprintJS"
  type      = "fingerprintjs-v3-am-device-identifier"
  configuration = jsonencode({})
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String) JSON configuration for the device identifier plugin
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `name` (String) The name of the device identifier
- `type` (String) The device identifier plugin type

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the device identifier
